source.label: Strategy-return correlations computed but not persisted
source.scope: Pairwise correlation of strategy returns over the common research window
source.caveat: The pairwise strategy-return correlations were computed in the cross-sectional-momentum-v1 diagnostics but are not persisted in the repository, so no value is rendered here. Separately: the only correlations published as an artefact (reports/cross_asset_validation.md) are between ASSETS inside EMA-v1, not between strategies. They answer a different question and are deliberately not reused here.
